name: fantasy
label: Fantasy
css: .style-fantasy { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF) 0%, rgba(2, 80, 204, 0.08) 100%); position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 80px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'New Rocker', cursive; } .style-fantasy::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #0250CC) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.12; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-fantasy .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -2px; margin: 0; text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(2, 80, 204, 0.15); z-index: 2; } .style-fantasy .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; z-index: 2; } .style-fantasy .step { position: absolute; top: 48px; right: 48px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; } .style-fantasy .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 48px; left: 48px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; margin: 0; z-index: 2; } .slide-code.style-fantasy { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, rgba(2, 80, 204, 0.2) 100%); color: #e0e0e0; } .slide-code.style-fantasy .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #0250CC); text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(2, 80, 204, 0.4); } .slide-code.style-fantasy .text { color: #e0e0e0; } .slide-code.style-fantasy .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #0250CC); } .slide-code.style-fantasy .step { color: rgba(253, 200, 0, 0.15); } .slide-insight.style-fantasy { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0e27 0%, rgba(2, 80, 204, 0.25) 100%); } .slide-insight.style-fantasy .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #0250CC); text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(2, 80, 204, 0.5); } .slide-insight.style-fantasy .text { color: #f5f5f5; } .slide-insight.style-fantasy .insight-text { font-size: 42px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #ffffff; background: rgba(2, 80, 204, 0.15); padding: 40px; border-left: 4px solid var(--slide-primary, #0250CC); border-radius: 4px; margin: 0; z-index: 2; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(2, 80, 204, 0.2); } .slide-insight.style-fantasy .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #0250CC); }
